description: Not affiliated with the U.S. government, GSA, or SAM.gov. Not a U.S. government service. Amtrak business opportunities from Amtrak's public procurement portal, construction, non-construction services, and equipment sales that do not appear on SAM.gov - Amtrak publishes through its own portal. Amtrak rotates active solicitations off the public listing after about a week; this feed refreshes daily. Filter by keyword or category. Metadata only; full documents live on Amtrak's portal. Present as information only. One search counts as one use, regardless of how many records are returned. Every record carries a direct source link (or source name and record ID) so you can verify and cite the underlying record.
